acnh.intro: Goldie is a normal dog villager in the who appears in all games to date. Her name is likely derived from the, a breed of dog which she bears a resemblance to. Her catchphrase is onomatopoeia of a dog's bark, relating to her species.
acnh.appearance: Goldie resembles a Golden Retriever in villager form — golden fur with beige patches on muzzle, paws, feet, tail, and ears, plus a beige spot by her left eye. Her eyes are oblong, brown around the sclera with bright white pupils.
acnh.personality: Goldie's normal kindness feels motherly — she asks how she can help and means it. Hobbies interest her without obsession; she stays neutral and gentle about fishing, fashion, or furniture. Favors make her anxious to impose; she apologizes for asking and rarely angers, though sadness comes easily. Cranky villagers test her patience; snooty neighbors can too. Friendship takes patience — photos and close trust arrive after many kind visits. She rises at five in the morning and sleeps at one, early bird in every sense. Like many normal villagers she may request specific clothing to collect, rewarding loyal helpers with her picture over time. Her sensitivity is the through-line: a golden dog who wants everyone comfortable, even when that means swallowing her own worry.

villagerInfo.quote: A little bit of happiness is better than a lot of anguish.
